title: Account
hosted: Sign-in is handled by the application Timeclock runs in.
limited: You came in through your workspace’s single sign-on, so how this account signs in can’t be changed from here. Sign in with your password to change it.

password.title: Password
password.set: You sign in with a password.
password.none: This account has no password: it signs in through single sign-on.
password.description: You stay signed in here, and are signed out everywhere else.
password.rule: At least 10 characters. A few words work well.

totp.title: Authenticator app
totp.isOff: After your password, sign-in also asks for a code from an app on your phone.
totp.isOn: Sign-in asks for a code from your authenticator app after your password.
totp.gate: Confirm it’s you before adding a second step.
totp.offDescription: Sign-in will ask only for your password. Your recovery codes stop working.
totp.qr: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
totp.scan: Scan this with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.

recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
recovery.description: If you lose your phone, each of these signs you in once instead of a code. They are shown only now.
recovery.left: {count, plural, =0 {No recovery codes left.} one {# recovery code left.} other {# recovery codes left.}}

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.about: A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN, with no password or code.
passkeys.gate: Confirm it’s you. Your browser will then ask where to keep the passkey.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.nameHint: So you can tell them apart, such as “Work laptop”.
